text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Strange. I thought someone called my 
name, but—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the statue of the Three Goddesses... 
The "foundation" that leads to modern 
Umamusume, huh.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...I must continue to hone myself to do 
our great predecessors proud."
